claims.claim: 速效救心丸（Suxiao Jiuxin Pill）是广泛用于中国心绞痛治疗的中成药复方，主要成分为川芎嗪（tetramethylpyrazine）与冰片（borneol）。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill, a compound Chinese traditional medicine with main components of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol, is widely used for antiangina treatment in China
claims.applicability: 中国；本品成分与抗心绞痛用途的公开记载。
claims.uncertainty: 此为期刊对本品成分与用途的描述，非说明书原文；说明书官方现行文本未独立核验。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析纳入 41 项随机对照试验共 6276 名冠心病患者，报告速效救心丸较其他治疗改善心电图结果（RR 1.32，95%CI 1.26 to 1.38，P<0.001）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 已确诊冠心病心绞痛人群；不覆盖无冠心病诊断的睡眠剥夺相关心悸。
claims.uncertainty: 纳入研究以中国出版物为主、多数 Jadad 评分低（无双盲）；结局为心电图改善而非临床事件。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析报告速效救心丸组不良反应发生率与对照组无显著差异（RR 1.12，95%CI 0.50 to 2.51，P=0.785）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 已确诊冠心病心绞痛人群的随机对照试验汇总。
claims.uncertainty: 14 项研究报告不良反应，报告质量低；未分析心血管死亡或药物相关并发症。

claims.claim: NHS 将突发且不缓解的胸痛或不适、放射至左臂或右臂或颈或下颌或胃或背部的疼痛、以及胸痛伴出汗、恶心、头晕或气促列为需即刻呼叫急救（999）的情形。
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: - you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion - you get pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or your neck, jaw, stomach or back - you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath
claims.applicability: 英国 NHS 官方患者指引；警示特征与呼叫急救义务适用于任何司法辖区，中国对应拨打 120。
claims.uncertainty: 英国院前指引，非中国指南；警示特征清单与急救义务方向一致。

claims.claim: 睡眠剥夺后 LF 显著升高（SMD 0.39，95%CI 0.15–0.63）、LF/HF 显著升高（SMD 1.47，95%CI 0.62–2.33），HF 呈下降趋势但未达统计学意义（SMD −0.23，95%CI −0.46 至 0.01）。
claims.sourceTitle: Effects of sleep deprivation on heart rate variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: The results revealed that low-frequency power (LF) significantly increased following sleep deprivation (SMD = 0.39, 95% CI: 0.15–0.63, p = 0.002), and the LF/HF ratio also showed a significant rise (SMD = 1.47, 95% CI: 0.62–2.33, p = 0.0007). In contrast, high-frequency power (HF) demonstrated a downward trend, although the result did not reach statistical significance (SMD = −0.23, 95% CI: −0.46 to 0.01, p = 0.06).
claims.applicability: 健康受试者与轮班人群的睡眠剥夺实验；结局为 HRV 替代指标而非心悸。
claims.uncertainty: 多数研究未实现盲法；LF/HF 生理学解释存在争议；结局为自主神经中间指标。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析报告睡眠剥夺后 RMSSD 显著下降（SMD −0.24，95%CI −0.47 至 −0.00）。
claims.sourceTitle: Effects of sleep deprivation on heart rate variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: The meta-analysis showed Z = 1.98, p < 0.05, with an SMD of −0.24 and a 95% confidence interval (−0.47, −0.00).
claims.applicability: 健康受试者与轮班人群的睡眠剥夺实验；RMSSD 反映迷走张力。
claims.uncertainty: 结局为自主神经中间指标而非心悸；多数研究未实现盲法。

claims.claim: 孟德尔随机化 meta 分析报告遗传预测的短睡眠与冠心病（OR 1.24，95%CI 1.15–1.34）和心肌梗死（OR 1.20，95%CI 1.12–1.28）风险升高相关。
claims.sourceTitle: Associations between sleep duration and cardiovascular diseases: A meta-review and meta-analysis of observational and Mendelian randomization studies
claims.supportQuote: Genetically predicted short sleep duration was associated with an increased risk of CAD (OR = 1.24, 95% CI = 1.15–1.34, P < 0.001) and MI (OR = 1.20, 95% CI = 1.12–1.28, P < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 遗传学因果推断；结局为冠脉事件而非心悸。
claims.uncertainty: MR 依赖工具变量假设；结局为冠脉事件，对心悸主诉间接。

claims.claim: 观察性 meta 分析报告以 7 小时为参照，睡眠每减少 1 小时冠心病相对风险为 1.11（95%CI 1.05–1.16）。
claims.sourceTitle: Associations between sleep duration and cardiovascular diseases: A meta-review and meta-analysis of observational and Mendelian randomization studies
claims.supportQuote: Compared with 7 h sleep per day, the RR of CHD was 1.11 (95% CI = 1.05–1.16, I 2 = 58.9%) for each 1 h reduction
claims.applicability: 观察性前瞻队列汇总；结局为冠脉事件而非心悸。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性研究存在残余混杂；睡眠时长以问卷测量。

claims.claim: 基于工时注册数据的瑞典医护队列报告永久夜班者缺血性心脏病风险升高（HR 1.61，95%CI 1.06–2.43）、年值夜班超 120 次者风险升高（HR 1.53，95%CI 1.05–2.21）。
claims.sourceTitle: Night and shift work characteristics and incident ischemic heart disease and atrial fibrillation among healthcare employees – a prospective cohort study
claims.supportQuote: The risk of IHD was increased among employees who the preceding year had permanent night shifts compared to those with permanent day work [hazard ratio (HR) 1.61, 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.06–2.43] and among employees working night shifts >120 times per year compared to those who never worked night (HR 1.53, 95% CI 1.05–2.21).
claims.applicability: 瑞典医护人群、注册工时；结局为缺血性心脏病事件而非心悸。
claims.uncertainty: 未校正吸烟、血压、糖尿病等生活方式混杂；健康工人效应可能低估风险。

claims.claim: 该瑞典医护队列未观察到夜班与房颤风险增加，且其讨论明确其结果不支持英国生物银行关于夜班增加房颤风险的发现。
claims.sourceTitle: Night and shift work characteristics and incident ischemic heart disease and atrial fibrillation among healthcare employees – a prospective cohort study
claims.supportQuote: Our results do not support the findings of the previous study by Wang et al ( 19 ) that employees with permanent night shifts and working an average of 3–8 nights per month increase the risk of incident AF.
claims.applicability: 瑞典医护人群；夜班与房颤关联的阴性结果，并与自我报告工时的英国生物银行结果不一致。
claims.uncertainty: 单队列阴性结果；暴露测量方式（注册工时对自我报告）可能是差异来源。

claims.claim: 以心悸就诊并确诊为室上性心动过速的急诊成人中，心房颤动是最常见诊断，其次为窦性心动过速。
claims.sourceTitle: Recognizing supraventricular tachyarrhythmias in female patients: beyond palpitations to symptoms like anxiety, panic, and nausea.
claims.supportQuote: Across all patients, AF was the most common diagnosis, followed by sinus tachycardia
claims.applicability: 瑞士三级医院急诊室室上性心动过速人群。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心回顾性队列；急诊选择性人群而非院外自我处置人群。

claims.claim: 该急诊研究中的全部患者（100%）接受了心电图检查。
claims.sourceTitle: Recognizing supraventricular tachyarrhythmias in female patients: beyond palpitations to symptoms like anxiety, panic, and nausea.
claims.supportQuote: All patients received an ECG (n= 278, 100%) and a blood sample (n=278, 100%) on ED admission.
claims.applicability: 急诊室室上性心动过速人群；提示心悸均需心电图评估。

claims.claim: 焦虑与恶心等症状可掩盖真实室上性心动过速，对所有以心悸、焦虑或恶心就诊者应低阈值获取心电图。
claims.sourceTitle: Recognizing supraventricular tachyarrhythmias in female patients: beyond palpitations to symptoms like anxiety, panic, and nausea.
claims.supportQuote: the need to consider arrhythmia in the differential diagnosis and to obtain an electrocardiogram in patients presenting with palpitations, anxiety or nausea
claims.applicability: 急诊室室上性心动过速人群；“神经性心慌”归因须以心电图排除心律失常为前提。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心回顾性队列；结论为提示性而非因果关系。

claims.claim: 该铸造厂工人研究纳入 286 名夜班工人与 100 名白班工人。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluation of ECG Repolarization Parameters in a Worker Cohort Working the Night Shift
claims.supportQuote: We included 286 foundry workers who work at night shift and 100 foundry workers who work on day time only.
claims.applicability: 铸造厂夜班与白班工人。
claims.uncertainty: 回顾性横断面设计；仅男性工人。

claims.claim: 夜班工人的 P 波离散度、QT 离散度与校正 QT 离散度均较白班工人增加。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluation of ECG Repolarization Parameters in a Worker Cohort Working the Night Shift
claims.supportQuote: Pd, QTd and QTcd values increased in the night shift workers compared to the day time workers (p < 0.05).
claims.applicability: 轮班作业人群；结局为心电复极离散度指标。
claims.uncertainty: 横断面设计；复极指标为心律失常倾向的替代指标而非临床事件。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析亚组分析显示速效救心丸较丹参片（RR 1.54，95%CI 1.41 to 1.67）、硝酸甘油（RR 1.35，95%CI 1.16 to 1.56）与二硝酸异山梨酯（RR 1.14，95%CI 1.05 to 1.22）改善心电图结果更明显。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The subgroup analyses indicated that suxiao jiuxin pill improved ECG results more than salvia tablets (RR 1.54; 95% CI 1.41 to 1.67, P < 0.001), isosorbide dinitrate (RR 1.14; 95% CI 1.05 to 1.22, P = 0.001), nitroglycerin (RR 1.35, 95% CI 1.16 to 1.56, P < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 已确诊冠心病心绞痛人群的随机对照试验亚组汇总。
claims.uncertainty: 亚组纳入研究质量低；结局为心电图改善而非临床事件。

claims.claim: 观察性 meta 分析报告短睡眠（较 6–8 小时）与全因死亡（RR 1.16，95%CI 1.11–1.22）和心血管死亡（RR 1.26，95%CI 1.12–1.41）相关。
claims.sourceTitle: Associations between sleep duration and cardiovascular diseases: A meta-review and meta-analysis of observational and Mendelian randomization studies
claims.supportQuote: short sleep duration was associated with all-cause mortality (RR = 1.16, 95% CI = 1.11–1.22) and cardiovascular mortality (RR = 1.26, 95% CI = 1.12–1.41) compared with normal sleep duration (6–8 h/day)
claims.applicability: 观察性前瞻队列汇总；结局为死亡而非心悸。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性研究存在残余混杂；睡眠时长以问卷测量。

claims.claim: 按说明书所界定的适应症（气滞血瘀型冠心病心绞痛）衡量，无冠心病诊断的一过性心悸与伴警示特征的心悸均不在该适应症范围内，仅已确诊冠心病者的心绞痛发作落在其内。
claims.method: 以说明书适应症条款“用于气滞血瘀型冠心病，心绞痛”为限定条件：该条款以冠心病诊断为适用前提，故无冠心病诊断的一过性心悸（情境一）不落入限定范围；伴警示特征、需即刻急救评估的未分化胸痛（情境二，见 CLM-004）由急救指引界定而非由本品适应症界定；已确诊冠心病者的心绞痛发作（情境三）以冠心病诊断为已具备前提，若符合气滞血瘀证型则落入。该归类是条款字面范围的映射，未引入说明书未明示的内容。
claims.assumptions: 适应症条款中的“冠心病、心绞痛”以冠心病诊断为适用前提；说明书索引件措辞与官方现行文本一致。
claims.sensitivity: 若官方现行说明书的适应症或注意事项措辞与索引件不同，三类情境的归类边界随之改变。
claims.applicability: 中国（NMPA）注册中成药适应症边界的三类临床情境映射。
claims.uncertainty: 为对说明书字面范围的解读而非说明书明示的分类；说明书文本依据索引记录、官方现行文本未独立核验。
